selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：双珊瑚柱、居中女祭司、闭合书与石榴枝清楚，海底藏书廊向后延伸；仅执行者选定母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque 1024x1536 vertical tarot illustration, High Priestess theme 潮底秘典 / Submerged Secret Archive. Use attached original only for identity and tarot style: exactly one serene dark-haired veiled priestess in indigo-violet robes sits facing forward between EXACTLY TWO tall coral columns. Her TWO hands rest on ONE closed ornate book across her lap. One pomegranate branch hangs to one side. Beyond her, a deep underwater library corridor recedes into blue-green distance with archive shelves and soft luminous fish, but no other people. Deep teal, garnet red and pearl white palette, natural skin tone. Seat, flowing skirt and front steps form one uninterrupted solid support extending into the bottom bleed. Coral columns act as side frame, book and hands clearly visible, no duplicate priestess in reflections. Refined hand-painted fantasy tarot with thin celestial gold edge, lovely atmospheric depth. No letters on book, no title, typography, logo or watermark. Full opaque master ready for later layers.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.
